scope: Minimum finite-triangle feature distance on selected hand and hip/thigh surface regions, including triangles crossing the >0.5 bone-weight selection boundary. Tests vertex-face, edge-edge and edge-through-face crossings. BVH sphere pruning bounds possible closer pairs. A 2 mm engineering margin is independent of the prior10 mm axis proxy. Selected regions are not closed volumes: this does not prove whole-body containment/collision correctness, transitions, or unsampled times.
